value.rationale: The intrinsic inverse-image geometry of a finite ring is a natural invariant for known open cellular automata, motivated directly by the explicit finite image-size/image-structure desiderata P1-P3 in Haugland/Omland almost-liftings research. The new all-ring membership criterion determines which half of each finite state space is attainable, not merely a generic image-size or fiber bound. The precise split between singleton and distance-1,2,3 two-marker forbidden outputs distinguishes globally two-to-one systems, supplying a nontrivial qualitative structural boundary with an all-N proof; it is not a small-N enumeration, mere renamed known theorem, or arbitrary sampled statistic.
